schedules.notes:
Purpose: one short Czech morning message to David. Source: the CEO's only routine (2026-10 lean org).

Follow 'Weekday morning summary' in your instructions: what reached customers yesterday (numbers), what waits for him (approvals, cards) with links, the top problem and who fixes it. Nothing to report: one line.
